title: OPEN-ENDED VQA BENCHMARKING OF VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS BY EXPLOITING CLASSIFICATION DATASETS AND THEIR SEMANTIC HIERARCHY

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a human evaluation study to compare traditional automated NLP metrics (e.g., Exact Match, BLEU, METEOR) against human judgments, demonstrating that conventional metrics exhibit a bias by unfairly penalizing models that generate longer, conversational responses.
